old:
borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    height: ROW_HEIGHT,
    justifyContent: "center",
    minHeight: ROW_MIN_HEIGHT,
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ConversationList.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R3: every row is at least a 44pt target"

label: the pending badge stops drawing, so waiting approvals go unspoken (R-rn-list-2)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ConversationList.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R3: a row with two pending items shows 2 with a spoken label"

label: an empty-device group builds a section, suppressing the empty and offline words (R-rn-list-2)
old:
const hasRows = state.groups.some((device) => device.count > 0);
  const sections = hasRows ? sectionsOf(state.groups) : [];
new:
const hasRows = state.groups.some((device) => device.count > 0);
  const sections = sectionsOf(state.groups);
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ConversationList.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R3: an empty-device group does not hide the empty or offline state"
